== Merged Pat Dinelle into Patrick Dinelle, 24 November 2026 ==
Merged the former page [[Patrick Dinelle|Pat Dinelle]] (revision 370870) into [[Patrick Dinelle]] under the small-world rule, as ruled by Bill on 24 November 2026 (work ticket #1338). Pat Dinelle's page stated that he posted on the Players Committee forum as PatThePotato, signing as Patrick Dinelle, and both pages place him in Montreal. Moved over unchanged: the [[2001 Montreal DPC]] result (DeckTech report d2879), the 2004 forum posts (pcf-4007-55194, pcf-4035-55547), the 2004 Toronto tournament 2nd place, the [[2008 Match Play Championship]] Day 1 decklists, the See also links and Category:2001. The Tournament Results tables were merged in date order. [[Patrick Dinelle|Pat Dinelle]] is now a redirect to [[Patrick Dinelle]]; Talk:Pat Dinelle had no content. The 2008 MPC Day 1 decklist pages keep their "Pat Dinelle" titles as printed in the source.
